translation.name: Kameethari Ñaantsi: ikenkitha-takoitziri awinkatharite Jesucristo; Owakerari aapatziya-wakagaantsi

content: Retsiyatakotakagaitziri kisopookiri
Okanta otsipa kiteesheri, tsireniityaanake ramanapiintaitantari. Ari ritonkaanakeri Pedro itsipatanakari Juan, riyaatero tasorentsipankoki.

Ari ritonkyotakotantaka ramaitziri kisopookitatsiri. Rashi rowiro owakera itzimapaake. Maawoini kiteesheri ramaitapiintziri omooki tasorentsipanko iitaitziro “Owaneenkaanto”. Ari risaikapiintziri impashiyetantyaariri koriki ikowakoyetziriri kyaayetatsiri.
Ikanta jirika iñaawakeri Pedro itsipatakari Juan, iro inkyaantapaakyaarime tasorentsipankoki, ikowakotawakeri impashitanakyaari koriki.
Ari ipampoyaanakeri. Ikantziri: “¡Paminena!”
Ikemisantatzi kisopookiri, roshiyakaatzi impatyeeri jimpe oitya.

Iri kantacha Pedro, ikantanakeri: “Tekaatsi noorikite, te itzimi eejatzi ooro, iro kantacha eenitatsi nantzimotemiri. ¡Pinkatziye! ¡Panashitai! Naakotatziimiri iwairo Jesucristo Nazaret-satzi, iriitake antemirone.”
Rakathatakeri, ipiriintakeri. Omapokashitanaka ishintsitanai iitziki eejatzi ishoonketziki.
Ari rimitaanake ikatziyanaka, anashitanaka. Itsipatanakari jirikapaini ikyaapaake tasorentsipankoki, anashiwaitanaawo, mitaamitaawaitanai, ithaamentanaari Pawa.
Ithonka iñagaitakeri ranashitanaa, ikemaitakeri eejatzi ithaamentawaita.
Riyokitziiwentaitanakero iñagaitakerowa awisaintsiri, te rikompiyeetawakari jirika, iriitake kowakotantapiintatsiri impashiyeetyaari janta omooki tasorentsipanko, iitaitziri “Owaneenkaanto”.
Ikenkithatakaantzi Pedro ikyaapiintaitzira tasorentsipankoki

Ikanta kisopookiwetachari, te rookanakeri Pedro itsipatakari Juan. Iyokitziiwenta rowanakeri atziripaini, intsipaiteperoini ipiyowentapaakari awisashetakera tasorentsipanko iitaitziro “Rashi Salomón”.

Ikanta iñaawakeri Pedro, ikantawakeri: “¡Shiramparipaini! ¡Judá-ite! ¿Iitaka piyokitziiwentantanari? Eero pikenkithashiryaashiwaita naaka ashitawo noshintsinka, naaka tasorentsi nimatantariri nanashitakagaari jirika.

Iwawane Abraham-ni, Isaac-ni, Jacob-ni, iwawanetanakari eejatzi acharineete, iriitake matakerori jiroka, ari onkantya impinkathaitantyaariri Itomi Jesús, paakaantakeri eerokapaini janta jewaripainiki. Ikowawetaka Pilato romishitowakaantairime, te pikowimaita eerokapaini.
Iriitakeme pomishitowakaantaime Tasorentsitatsiri, matzirori itampatzikashiretzi, pomishitowakaantashitaari tsitokantaneri.
Iro opoñaantari powamaantakariri añaashiretakaantaneri. Iri kantacha Pawa rowañagairi. Noñagaiyawairini naakapaini rañagai.

Okaatzi etsiyatakotakagairiri kisopookiri piñaapiintziri eerokapaini, iro matakaakeriri rawentaashirenka ikemakenaga naakotakeri iwairo Jesús. Irootake piñaantakariri iroñaaka retsiyatakotai kameethaperoini.
Iyekiite, niyotzi naaka, te piyoperotero okaatzi pantayetakeri, ari roshiyakemi eejatzi peewarepaini.
Ari ikenakairori Pawa rimonkaatziro okaatzi ikenkithatakaayetakeriri maawoini Kamantantaneriite, ikantake: ‘Aritake inkemaatsitakagaitakyaari Cristo paata.’

Irootake pipiyashitantaiyaariri eerokapaini Pawa, pipakaayetairo piyaariperonka, oshiyawaitaiyaawome roshetakotaatyeerome irirori pikaariperowetakaga. Ari piñagairo intsipashiretaimi Awinkatharite, retsinaryaashiretakagaimi.
Aritake rotyaantairi Pawa eejatzi Jesucristo, tema ikashaakayitakemiro pairani aritake ripiye.
Onkantawetakya risaike Jesucristo inkiteki irojatzi inkowapaitetantakyaari Pawa rowakeratakagairo maawoini okantawetaga pairani. Iro ikenkithatakaayetakeriri Tasorentsishireri Kamantantaneriite.
Iro ikenkithatakotakeri pairani Moisés-ni, ikantake:

content.text: Ari rotyaantake paata Pawa itsipa Kamantantaneri, ari roshiyapaakena naaka rotyaantakenaga.
Asheninka rinatye. Maawoini inkamantayetapaakairi, ontzimatye ankemisantero.
Maawoini kaari kemisanterine jirika Kamantantaneri, ari rithonkayeetakeri,

content: Ari roshiyakari eejatzi Samuel-ni, ikenkithatakotakero okaatzi añaayetakeri iroñaaka, irojatzi ikenkithatakoyetakeri eejatzi maawoini itsipapaini Kamantantaneriite.

Eerokayetake ñeerone okaatzi ikowakaantakeri Pawa ikenkithatakoyetakeri Kamantantaneriite. Eerokayetake ñeerone eejatzi okaatzi raapatziyawakaantari pairani Pawa itsipatakari acharineete. Tema Pawa ikantakeri Abraham-ni:

content.text: Iri picharine tasonkawentairine maawoini sheninkatawakagaachari tsikarikapaini janta kipatsiki.

content: Ikanta rowañagairi Pawa itomi, retakari rotyaantakemiri eerokapaini, ompoñaantyaari ritasonkawentemi. Iroowa pipakaantaiyaawori maawoini eerokapaini piyaariperonka.”
